title: 第105章：他算什么东西？
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

张老头将秦昭岚之前说的话，跟山匪们说了一遍。

山匪们消化了一会儿，明白了他说的租赁和买卖制度，对这个制度非常满意。

众人按照秦昭岚的意思，先让山匪们选择了房间。

剩下的房间，则让大家选。

山匪们盖的是三层楼的房子，楼上的房子带露台，风景不错，需要的工分也是最多的。

苏安安喜欢三楼，抬起小手，指向三楼最右边的屋子。

“娘亲，我们住这间好不好？”

“好！”秦昭岚宠溺地点头，“安安想住哪间，咱们就住哪间。”

经过一个多月的采矿，苏安安赚了不少积分。

她大气地一挥手，租下了三楼的三间房，一共给山匪们划了十二万工分。

一层楼八间房，大当家和其他山匪，在一二楼各选了两间房，三楼选了三间。

如今苏安安又占了三间，三楼顿时只剩下两间房了。

刘大勇见三楼这么抢手，立刻先下手为强。

“你们谁都别跟我抢，三楼的两间房，我要一间！”

“大勇哥，你看你一个人住一间房，是不是有点太奢侈了？要不然咱们合租，一人出一半工分，如何？”

男人不敢跟刘大勇抢，也舍不得一次性出这么多的工分，便提出了合租的提议。

刘大勇一听，点头同意了。

“行，我跟你合租！”

刘大勇定下一间房，三楼还剩下一间。

其他人也想住三楼，可三楼是最贵的，一时间都在犹豫。

张老头见大家不选，缓步上前。

“我老了，腿脚不方便，就不跟你们抢楼上的房间了，我要一楼的房间。”

“我太馋了，工分大部分花在吃上面了。三楼的房租太贵，我也选一楼吧！”

“我富裕，我要三楼，有没有要跟我合租的？”

众人凑在一起，自行组队合租。

合租能减轻工分压力，大多数人选择了相对更划算的季租。

不过一刻钟，24间房就被租出去了一大半。

看着剩下的房间，山匪苦恼地挠挠头。

“大当家，房子是不是盖多了啊？”

“怕什么？多出来的房间，咱们兄弟轮流住单间！”

大当家叉着腰，眼眸里是掩饰不住的笑意。

他们忙活了一个多月，终于到了赚工分的时候了。

“大当家，你们今天一共收入56万8千工分。加上小小，你们一共有17个人，每个人可以分33411工分。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Old man Zhang told the bandits what Qin Zhaolan said before.

The bandits digested it for a while, understood the leasing and buying and selling system he mentioned, and were very satisfied with this system.

Everyone followed Qin Zhaolan's wishes and let the bandits choose the room first.

The remaining rooms are for everyone to choose.

The bandits built a three-story house. The house upstairs had a terrace, a nice view, and required the most work points.

Su Anan liked the third floor. She raised her little hand and pointed to the rightmost room on the third floor.

"Mom, can we live in this room?"

"Okay!" Qin Zhaolan nodded fondly, "We will live in whichever room An An wants to live in."

After more than a month of mining, Su Anan earned a lot of points.

She waved her hand grandly and rented three rooms on the third floor, giving the bandits a total of 120,000 work points.

There were eight rooms on the first floor. The boss and the other bandits chose two rooms on the first and second floors, and three rooms on the third floor.

Now that Su Anan has occupied three more rooms, there are only two rooms left on the third floor.

Seeing that the third floor was so popular, Liu Dayong immediately took the initiative.

"None of you are trying to rob me. I want one of the two rooms on the third floor!"

"Brother Dayong, do you think it's a bit too luxurious for you to live in a room by yourself? How about we share the room and pay half of the work points?"

The man did not dare to compete with Liu Dayong, and he was reluctant to pay so many work points at once, so he proposed a shared apartment.

Upon hearing this, Liu Dayong nodded in agreement.

"Okay, I'll share the room with you!"

Liu Dayong booked a room, but there was still one room left on the third floor.

Others also wanted to live on the third floor, but the third floor was the most expensive, so they hesitated for a while.

Seeing that everyone had no choice, Old Man Zhang stepped forward slowly.

"I'm old and my legs are inconvenient, so I won't compete with you for the room upstairs. I want the room on the first floor."

"I'm so greedy that I spend most of my work points on eating. The rent on the third floor is too expensive, so I'll choose the first floor too!"

"I'm rich. I want the third floor. Is there anyone you want to share with me?"

Everyone got together and formed their own teams to rent together.

Shared housing can reduce the pressure of work points, and most people choose quarterly rent, which is relatively more cost-effective.

Within a quarter of an hour, more than half of the 24 rooms were rented out.

Looking at the remaining rooms, the bandit scratched his head in distress.

"Master, have you built too many houses?"

"What are you afraid of? We brothers will take turns living in single rooms in the extra rooms!"

The headmaster had his hands on his hips, and there was a smile that couldn't be concealed in his eyes.

They had been busy for more than a month, and finally it was time to earn work points.

"Master, you have earned a total of 568,000 work points today. Including Xiaoxiao, there are 17 of you, and each of you can receive 33,411 work points.
